questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 2070 at a 15% profit. If the article is sold for Rs. 1890, then what will be the gain/loss percent?
questions.solution:
Cost price = (2070/115) × 100 = Rs. 1800

⇒ Profit = selling price – cost price = 1890 – 1800 = Rs. 90

⇒ Profit % = [Profit/Cost price] × 100 = [90/1800] × 100 = 5%

∴ Required profit percentage is 5%.

questions.question: What is the average of first seven prime numbers (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
First seven prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 and 17

Average = (2 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 + 13 + 17)/7

⇒ 58/7 = 8.29

**∴ The average of first seven prime numbers is 8.29**

questions.question: What is the smallest number which when increased by 5 is divisible by 12, 18 and 30?
questions.solution:
Factors of 12, 18 and 30

⇒ 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3 × 3

⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ L.C.M. of 12, 18 and 30 = 180

⇒ Required number = 180 – 5 = 175

∴ Required number is 175.

questions.question: For three numbers, the ratio of the first and the second number is 2 : 3 and that of the second and the third number is 4 : 5. If the sum of the three numbers is 140, then what is the second number?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ecd33aff69bdbc1d757812b97d2109d83ca831900f657780d42b1440ebc6094.png] **

Given that,

8x + 12x + 15x = 140

⇒ 35x = 140

⇒ x = 4

⇒ The second number = 12 × 4 = 48

∴ The second number is 48.

**Detailed Solution :**

The first number : The second number = (2 : 3) × 4 = 8 : 12

The second number : The third number = (4 : 5) × 3 = 12 : 15

⇒ The first number : The second number : The third number = 8 : 12 : 15

Let the first, second and third number is 8x, 12x and 15x

⇒ 8x + 12x + 15x = 140

⇒ 35x = 140

⇒ x = 4

⇒ The second number = 12 × 4 = 48

∴ The second number is 48.

questions.question: A is 20% more than B, which is 25% less than C. Which of the following is true about A and C?
questions.solution:

Let C be 100x

Then B will be 75x and A will be 120% of 75x

∴ A = 90x

Option 1 is correct

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the value of C be x

⇒ B = 3x/4

⇒ A = [3x/4] × 120% = 9x/10

⇒ A/C = 9/10

⇒ A/C = 0.9

⇒ A = 0.9C

∴ Required relation is A = 0.9C.

questions.question: A can do a piece of work alone in 8 days. B can do the same work alone in 21 days. If they work together for 3 days, then how much work is completed?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23ad24e5f38c02ec8365606de2691db353bb19795776aa5f24fcadd6b214d8c0.png] **

 

A and B together one day work will be 29 units.

3 day work is 3 × 29

∴ The work which is completed = (3 × 29)/168 ⇒ 29/56

**Detailed Solution : **

A can do a piece of work alone = 8 days

⇒ A can do a piece of work in 1 day = 1/8

⇒ A can do a piece of work in 3 day = 3/8

⇒ B can do a piece of work alone = 21 days

⇒ B can do a piece of work in 3 days = 3/21

⇒ They work together for 3 days = 3/8 + 3/21 = 87/168 = 29/56

∴ Complete part in 3 days is 29/56.

questions.question: The simple interest for 9 years on a principal is (3)/(5) of the principal. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest for 9 years = (3/5) × Principal

**Concept used:**

Simple interest, SI = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

P × R × 9/100 = (3/5) × P

R = (3/5) × (100/9) = 20/3%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the principal be 5x.

⇒ Simple interest = 3x

⇒ Simple interest = {{ }}frac{{PRT}}{{100}}

Rightarrow 3{{x}} = {{}}frac{{5x × R × 9}}{{100}}

⇒ R = 300/45 = 20/3 %

∴ The rate of interest per annum is 20/3%.

questions.question: The total surface area of a hollow cuboid is 340 cm². If the length and the breadth of the cuboid are 10 cm and 8 cm respectively, then what is the length of the longest stick that can be fitted inside the cuboid?
questions.solution:
Let the height of this cuboid be h.

 

⇒ Total surface area = 2[l × b + b × h + h × l]

⇒ 340 = 2[10 × 8 + 8 × h + h × 10]

⇒ 170 = 80 + 8h + 10h

⇒ 90 = 18h

⇒ h = 5 cm

⇒ The length of the longest stick = diagonal of cuboid

⇒ The length of the longest stick = √(l² + b² + h²) = √(100 + 64 + 25) = √189

⇒ The length of the longest stick = 3√21 cm

∴ The length of the longest stick that can be fitted inside the cuboid is 3√21 cm.

questions.question: A mixture has milk and water in the ratio (by volume) of 8 : 3 If 3 litres of water is added to it, then new ratio of milk and water becomes 2 : 1. What are the quantities of milk and water respectively in the mixture initially?
questions.solution:
Let the quantity of water initially be 3x.

⇒ Milk = 8x

Rightarrow frac{{3x + 3}}{{8x}} = (1)/(2)

⇒ 6x + 6 = 8x

⇒ x = 3

⇒ The quantities of milk in the mixture initially = 8x = 24 litres

⇒ The quantities of water in the mixture initially = 3x = 9 litres

∴ The quantities of milk and water respectively in the mixture initially are 24 litres and 9 litres.

questions.question: The side of a cube is 15 cm. What is the base area of a cuboid whose volume is 175 cm³ less than that of the cube and whose height 32 cm?
questions.solution:
Volume of a cube = side³ = 15³ = 3375 cm³

Volume of a cuboid = Volume of a cube – 175

Area of base × h = 3375 – 175

Area of base = 3200/32 = 100 cm²

∴ The base area of a cuboid is 100 cm².

questions.question: A boat can travel 60 km in 3 hours while going downstream, it can travel 90 km in 5 hours while going upstream. What is the ratio of the speed of boat in still water to the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of boat be B and the speed of stream be S.

⇒ Speed of the boat in downstream = 60/3 = 20 km/hour

⇒ Speed of the boat in upstream = 90/5 = 18 km/hour

⇒ Speed of the boat = (20 + 18)/2 = 19 km/hour

⇒ Speed of the stream = (20 – 18)/2 = 1` km/hour

⇒ Speed of the boat : Speed of the stream = 19 : 1

∴ Required ratio is 19 : 1.

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs 810 at a loss of 10%. What should be the selling price if the loss is 20%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price of article = Rs. 810

Loss = 10% 

New loss = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost price × (100 – loss)% = selling price

Selling price = cost price × (100 – loss)%

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Cost price × 90% = 810

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 900

If the loss is 20%,

Selling price = cost price × (100 – loss)%

Selling price = 900 × 80%

⇒ Selling price = 720

**∴ The selling price if the loss is 20%, will be Rs. 720.**

questions.question: The height of a right circular cone is 5 cm and its base radius is 12 cm. What is the curved surface area of the cone?
questions.solution:
h = 5 cm, r = 12 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3bd2488238f100e3877d1e5c08668618d6e50d6de5d62017d11640a4382094c.png] 

Let the lateral height be l,

⇒ l² = r² + h²

⇒ l² = 144 + 25 = 169

⇒ l = 13 cm

⇒ The curved surface area of the cone = π × r × l

⇒ The curved surface area of the cone = π × 12 × 13 = 156 π cm²

∴ The curved surface area of the cone is 156 π cm².

questions.question: The marks obtained by S5 is how much percentage more than the average marks of the students (correct to two decimal)?
questions.solution:
The marks obtained by S5 = 99

⇒ The sum of marks of the students = 92 + 88 + 87 + 94 + 99 + 97 + 86 + 85 + 100 + 91 = 919

⇒ The average marks of the students = 919/10 = 91.9

⇒ Percentage more than the average marks of the students = [(99 – 91.9)/91.9] × 100

⇒ Percentage more than the average marks of the students = [7.1/91.9] × 100 = 7.725 ≈ 7.73%

∴ Percentage more than the average marks of the students is 7.73%.
